name: myWalgreens Credit Card

base_rate.description: 5% on all other brands and eligible pharmacy purchases at Walgreens.

rewards.redemption_notes: Walgreens Cash rewards post to the myWalgreens member account for use on future Walgreens purchases.

signup_bonus.description: $50 in Walgreens Cash rewards after opening an account and making a first purchase within 45 days; the amount in personalized offers may vary.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. Usable at Walgreens, Duane Reade and Walgreens.com. Applicants are assigned the myWalgreens Credit Card or myWalgreens Mastercard based on credit. It is a closed-loop private-label card that does not run on a payment network, so network is other and network_tier is none.
